Name: Dexter's Holiday Decorations
Author: AmuTsukiyomi
Description:
Another "this is a hilarious idea to me, I'm going to make it!" mod.  Currently there's only holiday "furniture" for Christmas.....though I [i]might[/i] add in some for a couple others later on.  MIGHT.

As always, this requires a LOT of mods if you want to be able to place them all over the everywhere.  If you're just sprucing up the inside of the farmhouse, you only need the first three.

SMAPI
PyTK
Custom Furniture
Entoarox Framework (optional)
Furniture Anywhere (optional)
Custom Furniture Anywhere (optional)

Just drop the folder into the Furniture folder within Custom Furniture and you're all set to merrily murder-ify the valley for christmas!

[color=#cc0000][b]ASK TO USE MY SPRITES for other stuff, otherwise the answer is a default [i][u]ABSOLUTELY NO.[/u][/i][/b][/color]
